issue: Seed treats Meeting as a near-short-form of Race meeting, but France Galop defines Meeting as multiple réunions at one racecourse over a period, while Réunion is the same-day race collection.
decision_needed: Split Meeting by jurisdiction/sense; create a France-specific multi-réunion Concept or sense before any global merge with Race meeting.

issue: Off time cannot be globally fixed as scheduled start. ARCI defines it as the actual moment starting-gate doors open; GB/IRE operational usage must be separately verified.
decision_needed: Split scheduled vs actual start semantics by jurisdiction and revise MEET-028 scope/definition before public readiness.

issue: Racetrack can denote the whole venue or the physical track, so one exact-equivalence edge to Racecourse would erase a common sense.
decision_needed: Add sense-scoped definitions/evidence; decide whether physical-racetrack sense requires a separate Concept.

issue: Track can mean venue, running surface, or physical course/path depending on context.
decision_needed: Keep current related edges; collect authority examples by jurisdiction and decide whether Track should remain a polysemous Concept or be sense-split.

issue: Going and Track condition overlap but are not one universal taxonomy. GB Going, North American track-condition codes, JRA four-stage conditions and Australian numeric ratings differ structurally.
decision_needed: Decide whether Going is narrower than a broader surface-condition Concept or remains a jurisdiction-specific counterpart; do not mark exact-equivalent.

issue: Race day and Raceday are spelling variants already marked exact-equivalent.
decision_needed: Merge into one Concept plus orthographic/regional label during schema cleanup unless an authority-specific semantic distinction is found.

issue: Favorite and Favourite are spelling variants already marked exact-equivalent.
decision_needed: Merge into one Concept plus en-US/en-GB labels during schema cleanup.

issue: Bumper is a current colloquial/operational name for National Hunt Flat Race, so two Concept identities likely duplicate one underlying race type.
decision_needed: Prefer one Concept with Bumper/Bumpers as labels unless a jurisdiction rule creates a real distinction.

issue: Group and Grade occupy corresponding international quality levels but are authority/system labels, not universally interchangeable terminology.
decision_needed: Keep separate Concepts or model one abstract quality tier plus jurisdiction labels; never flatten Group into Grade by translation alone.

issue: North American Rabbit and France Galop tactical leader both describe pace-making for another horse with aligned interests, but exact semantic/entry-relationship equivalence is not yet established.
decision_needed: Collect rule/industry examples and choose close_equivalent, regional_counterpart, or two related Concepts.

issue: France Galop Musique is a compact recent-form notation and explicitly notes reverse ordering versus GB/IRE conventions; master lacks a general race-form-notation Concept.
decision_needed: Create a form-notation Concept, then model France notation and GB/IRE form strings as regional implementations/contrasts.

issue: Spell/Spelling is a deliberate recuperative break, while Layoff can simply denote an extended absence from racing.
decision_needed: Retain related relation; consider narrower/broader only after broader regional definitions are sourced.

issue: Mudlark is corroborated in current AU and NZ authority material as a horse that handles wet/heavy going well; no existing horse-aptitude Concept fits.
decision_needed: Decide standalone wet-track-aptitude Concept vs register-only label, then relate to surface-condition Concepts without treating horse aptitude as track state.

issue: Under double wraps and On the bit/bridle both describe travelling easily with little urging, while Off the bit/bridle is the contrasting pressured state.
decision_needed: Determine whether a broader travelling-easily Concept and contrast state should be created with regional labels.

issue: 一本かぶり and backed off the map both concern concentrated betting support but differ in whether the emphasis is overwhelming favorite concentration or market backing/movement.
decision_needed: Model a betting-market-support family and choose narrower/related/regional-counterpart relations rather than forcing synonymy.
